title: Tenth Light - Game Asset Manifest
description: Exhaustive inventory, technical frame specifications, palette allocation, and provenance metadata for all 2D vector pixel art assets in Tenth Light, adhering to the create-game-assets discipline.

invariants: Strict single-accent rule: #f0562b is the sole chroma accent across all assets
No off-palette blues, cyans, greens, or secondary purples
No linear or radial SVG gradient fills
No gaussian blur filters or drop-shadow filters
